decks.notes: The deck aims to aggressively burn the opponent with efficient red instants and sorceries, backed up by hasty creatures. The key concept is to play low-cost, high-impact cards to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of the companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den allows for additional value from the graveyard, ensuring a consistent stream of threats even in the later stages of the game. The deck prioritizes speed and direct damage to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on using "Hardened Scales" to maximize the value of +1/+1 counters on creatures, artifacts, and even lands. It aims to quickly build up a board state with creatures like Arcbound Ravager, Hangarback Walker, and Walking Ballista, while utilizing synergistic cards like Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and The Ozolith. Urza's Saga helps to tutor for key artifacts, while Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing you to recast low-cost creatures from your graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient, synergistic plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature, such as Ornithopter or Memnite, and then deal a huge amount of damage in one swing. The deck uses equipment tutors like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to find the pieces, along with Puresteel Paladin to help cast them for free. The deck also includes protection cards like Shadowspear and Sigarda's Aid to ensure the combo goes off smoothly and efficiently.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently play powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with efficient creatures and spells while controlling the game with versatile cards like Archmage's Charm and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is designed to allow for consistent casting of spells and to support the aggressive game plan of the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of interactive spells, removal, and value-generating cards to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It seeks to stabilize the board with cards like Solitude and Lightning Helix, while generating card advantage through cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Expressive Iteration. The deck also aims to ramp and fix mana with cards like Abundant Growth and Omnath, Locus of Creation. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a powerful companion, providing additional value and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to grind out the opponent and control the game until it can secure a win condition.

The deck focuses on creating explosive turns by casting low-cost cascade spells to cheat out powerful creatures and spells for free. Seasoned Pyromancer generates tokens and card advantage, while Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst trigger cascade and put additional threats on the board. The deck also includes interaction with cards like Fury, Brazen Borrower, and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, enabling the deck to pressure opponents early and overwhelm them with its aggressive tempo.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures, disruption spells, and versatile removal to steadily chip away at the opponent's life total. By controlling the board with cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil, and applying pressure with powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Bloodbraid Elf, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and close out the game quickly. The deck's mana base is carefully crafted to allow for consistent access to the necessary colors while also providing strong synergies with cards like Wrenn and Six.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing powerful spells like Chandra, Torch of Defiance, Lightning Bolt, and Utopia Sprawl to disrupt the opponent's strategy while ramping up to play big threats like Blood Moon, Bonecrusher Giant, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer, Fury, and Bloodbraid Elf for additional card advantage and board presence. The mana base is designed to support the Gruul color identity and provide consistent access to the spells needed to dominate the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Eidolon of the Great Revel, and Goblin Guide, along with a mix of burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Boros Charm to deal direct damage and control the board. The inclusion of companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den allows for additional value and recursion, while the mana base is designed to support a fast and consistent pace of play.

The key strategy of this deck is to aggressively play small creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Death's Shadow while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble to trigger abilities and Drown in the Loch to counter spells, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to activate the powerful Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck also has a versatile removal package with cards like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. Additionally, the deck utilizes Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion to provide additional value from the graveyard.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with Death's Shadow as a major threat while utilizing various disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch to control the opponent's resources. The inclusion of Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds another powerful threat to the board while Lurrus of the Dream-Den allows for recurring smaller creatures and artifacts. The deck combines disruption, aggression, and resource management to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory in the Modern format.

The primary focus of this deck is to play aggressively using powerful creatures like Death's Shadow and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value by returning low-cost permanents from the graveyard. Additionally, utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to dig for important pieces while providing card advantage. The deck aims to apply pressure quickly and efficiently while controlling the board state with disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay utilizing efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, supported by disruption from spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize. The presence of powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six helps to generate card advantage and provide additional value to the deck. The inclusion of cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Unholy Heat allows for disruption and removal, while the artifact package with Mishra's Bauble and Pyrite Spellbomb provides additional utility. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells to apply continuous pressure on the opponent. By including Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck can easily recur critical cards like Mishra's Bauble and Pyrite Spellbomb. The deck also takes advantage of the new Urza's Saga land to tutor for key artifacts and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of early aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly before they can stabilize.

This deck revolves around equipping Colossus Hammer onto small, evasive creatures like Ornithopter and Gingerbrute to deal massive damage quickly. With cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Sigarda's Aid to help search and equip, and Puresteel Paladin to draw cards and reduce equip costs, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient beatdowns. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Esper Sentinel and Thoughtseize to slow down the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence. The companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing the deck to recur key creatures.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to leverage fast, aggressive creatures like Ragavan and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. The deck also includes versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to deal with threats efficiently. Lurrus of the Dream-Den serves as a powerful companion option for additional value and resilience. The mana base is designed to support the low curve of the deck while also providing access to both black and red mana sources.
